label: PF Backlog 53
title: Intake E2E (backend): dedup + preserve source_platform provenance
body: core.intake.ingest never sets source_conversation_id -> re-sends duplicate conversations (observed). intake_adapters collapses non-chatgpt/gemini/claude sources to 'manual' (all stored conversations show source_platform=manual). Fix: set/check source_conversation_id for idempotent ingest; preserve the true source_platform for every adapter. Refs: core/intake.py:67-78, core/intake_adapters.py:152.
